lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: Hello, Commander :3

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: The name's Dipso, and I'm all about drinking and being merry.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance >~<
Nice to meet you too.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: I've only one question for you.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: Do you drink?
I do.
I don't.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: I knew it!

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: I can always smell a fellow drinker!

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: Oh, what a shame T^T

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: I hope that you'll one day experience the pleasure of alcohol.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: As for me, I can't live without having a drink.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: I've tried just about everything the Ark has to offer,

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: so I'm looking to try something new!

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: Can you bring me anything from the surface?
That won't be easy.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: Oh, believe me, I'm fully aware of that.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: I promise you'll be rewarded handsomely. Please? >~<

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: I'm dying to try something new! T^T
I'll see what I can do.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: Oooooh! Really?!

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: You'll do it?
I'll try.

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: I'm so excited!

lines.speaker: alchollover
lines.text: Thank you! ^____^
